current.text: Experts value him at about 70 USD in auctions. A price of 80 USD is a little high but not outrageous.
Experts see him as a safe top pick. His best case is 1st overall and his downside is around 5th. Nearly every draft takes him or Jokic first.
His minutes are expected to be managed somewhat, so he will not play 35 a night.
Fears about his durability are overblown, because the blood clot that shortened one season is not a repeatable injury.
Last season his blocks fell to a career low, but he still led the league. Opponents stopped challenging him at the rim, so he defended fewer shots there.
Teams are expected to keep avoiding shots at the rim against him in the regular season.

durable.text: Blocks are his biggest outlier, far above the top 250 pool. Points and rebounds are also league outliers.
Turnovers are his one weak category. He commits many more than the pool and more than other centers.
He helps in almost every category: points, rebounds, blocks, threes, both percentages and assists. Assists, threes and steals are his weakest positive categories.
He makes many threes for a center.
He does not win blocks by himself. A team still needs at least one other shot blocker.
Half of his rim contests turn into blocks.
He is called the best defender in the league.
He is one of the Spurs' best free throw shooters, though he missed many in the Finals.
He is still learning to score one-on-one when given the ball. It is not yet a strength.
He played about 65 games in two of the last three seasons. A blood clot caused the one shortened season.

note: Expect him to cost about 80 USD, close to the Yahoo and ESPN average costs. Our league paid 85 USD last season. The site values are only 60 to 65 USD and the experts' value is about 70 USD, so anything near 80 USD is a little high but defensible for a top 2 player who stands out in blocks, rebounds and points. He fits any build, especially punt TO, but you still need a second shot blocker to lock up blocks. Early in the season, check whether his minutes stay near 30 and whether his blocks climb back above last season's career low of 3.1.
